title: 2224. Minimum Number of Operations to Convert Time

examples.explanation: We can convert current to correct in 3 operations as follows: - Add 60 minutes to current. current becomes "03:30". - Add 60 minutes to current. current becomes "04:30". - Add 5 minutes to current. current becomes "04:35". It can be proven that it is not possible to convert current to correct in fewer than 3 operations.
We only have to add one minute to current, so the minimum number of operations needed is 1.
